Classroom.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initialize a new instance by storing the provided id unchanged and creating an empty courses list." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> id </REF>: any "The value to store in the instance attribute self.id without validation or transformation."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the incoming parameter id directly to the instance attribute self.id without modification. RESULT self.id]
            [COMMAND Initialize the instance attribute self.courses to a new empty list. RESULT self.courses]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Classroom.add_course:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Add the course to the course list only if it is not already present." add_course]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance containing the course collection."
        <REF> course </REF>: any "Course value to add if missing."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether the course is already present in self.courses. RESULT is_missing]
            [COMMAND If the course is not present, append it to self.courses; otherwise, do nothing. RESULT updated_courses]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Classroom.remove_course:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Removes a course from the user's course list only if it is already present." remove_course]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The instance containing the course collection."
        <REF> course </REF>: any "The course value to remove if present."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: None "No return value; the collection is updated in place when the course exists."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether the given course is present in self.courses. RESULT presence_check]
            [COMMAND If the course is present, remove it from self.courses in place. RESULT updated_courses]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Classroom.is_free_at:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Parses an input time string and returns whether it does not fall within any course's inclusive start-to-end time range." is_free_at]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> check_time </REF>: string "Time to check, expected in HH:MM format."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "True if the parsed check time is not within any course time interval; False if it falls within at least one course interval."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Parse the input check_time string using the fixed format '%H:%M' and overwrite check_time with the resulting datetime value. RESULT check_time]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each course in self.courses. RESULT course]
            [COMMAND Within the loop for each course, parse course['start_time'] using the format '%H:%M'. RESULT course_start_time]
            [COMMAND Within the loop for each course, parse course['end_time'] using the format '%H:%M'. RESULT course_end_time]
            [COMMAND Within the loop for each course, check whether course_start_time <= check_time <= course_end_time using inclusive boundaries on both comparisons. RESULT is_within_course_interval]
            [COMMAND Within the loop, if is_within_course_interval is true for the current course, return False immediately without checking any remaining courses. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND After the loop completes with no matching course interval found, return True. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: The input check_time string or any course start_time or end_time value does not match the required '%H:%M' format for datetime.strptime.]
        [LOG "Time parsing fails because a value is not a valid HH:MM string for the fixed '%H:%M' format."]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised by datetime.strptime when a time string cannot be parsed with the required format."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Classroom.check_course_conflict:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Checks whether a new course time interval conflicts with any existing course by comparing the start and end times against all stored courses using inclusive overlap boundaries." check_course_conflict]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance containing the existing courses list."
        <REF> new_course </REF>: dict "Dictionary with start_time and end_time string values in HH:MM format."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True when no conflict is found; False when either boundary of the new course falls within any existing course interval."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Parse new_course['start_time'] into new_start_time using datetime.strptime with the '%H:%M' format. RESULT new_start_time]
            [COMMAND Parse new_course['end_time'] into new_end_time using datetime.strptime with the '%H:%M' format. RESULT new_end_time]
            [COMMAND Initialize flag to True as the default no-conflict state. RESULT flag]
            [COMMAND For each course in self.courses, parse course['start_time'] into start_time using datetime.strptime with the '%H:%M' format. RESULT start_time]
            [COMMAND For each course in self.courses, parse course['end_time'] into end_time using datetime.strptime with the '%H:%M' format. RESULT end_time]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over self.courses, if start_time <= new_start_time and end_time >= new_start_time, set flag to False using inclusive boundary checks. RESULT flag]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over self.courses, if start_time <= new_end_time and end_time >= new_end_time, set flag to False using inclusive boundary checks. RESULT flag]
            [COMMAND After all courses are checked, return flag. RESULT flag]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: new_course is missing start_time or end_time, or any time string does not match the '%H:%M' format.]
        [LOG "datetime.strptime will fail while parsing the course time value."]
        [THROW ValueError or KeyError "Raised when time parsing fails or a required dictionary key is absent."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
